cli.dotnet.unavailable: The dotnet CLI could not be started: {reason}
cli.graph.description: Print the application's capability graph (forwards to 'dotnet run -- graph').
cli.invoke.description: Invoke an operation of the application (forwards to 'dotnet run -- invoke'); '<resource> <verb>' is a shorthand.
cli.migrate.description: Rewrite an application for a newer framework version using the rule set for its source version: migrate <source> [--path <dir|.csproj|.slnx>] [--fixers <ids>] [--dry-run] [--report <file>].
cli.migrate.dry_run: Dry run: no files were written.
cli.migrate.no_rule_sets: This version of the tool has no migration rule sets; '{version}' cannot be migrated.
cli.migrate.summary: {files} files touched, {changed} edits, {markers} markers left for review.
cli.migrate.version_unknown: No migration rule set for source '{version}'; available: {known}.
cli.operations.description: List the application's operations (forwards to 'dotnet run -- operations').
cli.pack.description: Generate deployment artifacts from xihan.app.json: pack [--manifest <path>] [--output <dir>] [--only dockerfile,kustomize,compose,aspire].
cli.pack.kind_unknown: Unknown artifact kind '{kind}'; expected dockerfile, kustomize, compose or aspire.
cli.pipeline.description: Print the application's pipeline (forwards to 'dotnet run -- pipeline').
